label: DisasterReady India - Public Portal & Evacuation Safety
title: DisasterReady India - Public Portal & Evacuation Safety
prompt:
DisasterReady India complete public portal home and evacuation safety engine screen.
Key elements:
1. Public Alert Banner: Orange Flood Warning ("Move to higher ground now. Rani river is above the danger level at Kharadi. Water is rising. Official: CWC & DDMA. Updated 4 minutes ago.") with "Get to safety" CTA.
2. 4 Large Full-Width Action Rows: "Get to safety (/safety/1)", "Ask for supplies (/supplies/1)", "Check my request (/track)", "Call for help (/emergency)".
3. Interactive Live Route Risk & Navigation engine (5.1):
- Full interactive SVG Map Graph (viewBox 0 0 100 100) with nodes N1 Gandhi Chowk, N2 Hanuman Temple, N3 Canal Rd underpass, N5 Ring Rd, N6 Hill Rd, N7 Market Rd, N8 Govt Girls High School, N9 Community Hall, N10 Sonpur Shelter, N11 District Hospital, N12 CHC Mohanpur.
- Edges with strict pattern coding: Safe (solid blue + check), Risky (dashed amber + triangle), Blocked (solid red + cross marks H1 underpass, H2 closed bridge).
- Route comparison panel: Route A (Shortest 18m, High hazard exposure 2 pts), Route B (Safest 24m, Low hazard 1 pt, RECOMMENDED with plain English reason "Recommended: Route B. It takes 6 minutes longer but avoids the flooded underpass and stays on higher ground"), Route C (Alternative 28m, Exposure None).
- Live Twist interactive trigger: Report landslide on Hill Road (e5) which switches recommendation dynamically to Route C (+4 min, +0.3 km) with side-by-side What Changed panel and instant undo.
- Mode switcher: Foot, Two-wheeler, Car, Ambulance. Needs tiles: Wheelchair (avoids steep e13), Elderly, Child, Pregnant, Alone.
- Full landmark turn-by-turn text directions working without map.
4. Language switcher (English / Hindi toggle with full string translation support), High-contrast toggle, Text size selector, and TTS Listen button using Web Speech API.
5. Persistent bottom emergency bar: "Emergency help: call 112" (#B3261E). All buttons minimum 48px touch target. Clean transit-signage aesthetic without gradients or glassmorphism.
